verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe OTLP-based tracing that captures nested spans for model calls, retrieval, and tool use (docs-38, docs-12/13/14), and Sessions explicitly group related traces into conversations/user sessions while Projects organize traces by application (docs-16/49). Auto-instrumentation for popular agent frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.) supports multi-step agent run tracing out of the box (docs-5, docs-32). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of nested span hierarchy rendering for complex multi-step agents beyond vendor docs.
